name: ndspy
notes: Python library installed from PyPI ndspy 4.2.0 into .venv/ (Python 3.12, uv). Matches upstream tag v4.2.0 (commit c5016497a540144a201b46186f984e6ffc2d1a74). The wheel's sha256 was not recorded, so sha256 is null and the PyPI-to-tag match is unverified. test.sh builds a tiny synthetic DS ROM, reloads and patches it, and round-trips LZ10 and NARC; it passed on 2026-10-16. Upstream is GPL-3.0.
